QUOTE: "The user taps the failed post, which opens a bottom sheet (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`). \"Try Again\" calls `retryFailedPost(serverUrl, post)`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry occurs only via the user's "Try Again" choice on the failed post, which calls `retryFailedPost`, and notes nothing re-sends in the background.
